title: Review of c34's two-kind trait-swap finding: on fresh seed 4 the swimming kind beats the neutral twin in both assignments (swap: B 0.53 vs 0.35; original: A 0.80 vs 0.65 of pure rods at frame 185), 0 kind switches in 3 runs; the split advantage is large in the original arm (23 vs 2) but not in the swap arm (14 vs 13)
summary: Ran the finding's world on seed 4 three times with labkit (T=1000): swap (mar=0, marB=40), neutral twin (mar=marB=40) and the original assignment (mar=40, marB=0), then the author's kinds.py and switches.py. Pure-rod shares at frame 185: neutral A 0.65 / B 0.35 (founder bias toward A on this seed); swap B 0.53 (+0.18 over neutral); original A 0.80 (+0.15). Both paired comparisons favour the kind that carries the Marangoni drive, extending the author's 6/6 to 8/8. switches.py: 0 kind switches along any of 97, 92 and 95 tracks, so the shift is carried by births and not by conversion. Persistent splits by parent kind: original A 23 vs B 2; swap A 13 vs B 14; neutral A 15 vs B 6, so the swimmer's split count rises over its neutral value in both arms (B 6 -> 14, A 15 -> 23), but in the swap arm swimmers do not out-divide non-swimmers in absolute terms as the summary states for seeds 0-2.

observations.H: rerun/kinds.txt: swimmer share above neutral in both assignments on seed 4 (+0.18, +0.15), 0 kind switches in 3 runs; persistent splits by parent kind 23/2 (original), 14/13 (swap), 15/6 (neutral)

seeds_run.result: pass: swimmer above neutral in both arms, no conversions

controls_run.H: rerun/neutral_seed4 (mar = marB = 40) as the paired neutral twin; trait swapped between kinds (rerun/swap_seed4, rerun/orig_seed4)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and one T=1000 window; the two arms share one neutral run. The neutral run already favours A (0.65), so founder composition matters and per-seed effects are of the size of that bias. In the swap arm swimmers and non-swimmers split about equally often (14 vs 13), so 'swimmers out-divide non-swimmers' holds relative to the neutral twin, not in absolute terms on this seed. Kind identity is a surfactant composition with coded majority feedback (src fA^2/(fA^2+fB^2)), so heredity is engineered while selection comes from the dynamics; I did not check the mechanism of the split advantage.
